_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Specification Tree
summary: Defines the hierarchical inter-relationship of the Government and Contractor specifications developed for a system as part of the Systems Engineering Technical Review (SETR) process.
use_relationship:
The Specification Tree defines hierarchical and inter-relationship of the specifications for the system.  The Specification Tree will be used to graphically depict the various Government and Contractor specifications that will be developed as part of the Systems Engineering Technical Review (SETR) process.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described by the contract statement of work.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: Contractor format acceptable and may be depicted in a format similar to Figure 1 example.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The specification tree shall contain the following:

children.title: Name of Government agency or Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM)
children.content: Name of Government agency or Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) developing the specification.

children.title: The Government system specification
children.content: The Government system specification provided as part of a contract will be at the top of the hierarchical order of the specification tree.

children.title: The SETR event and Baseline
children.content: Identify the SETR event and Baseline each specification pertains to.  The SETR events include Systems Requirements Review 2 (SRR-2), System Functional Review (SFR), Software Specification Review (SSR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), and Critical Design Review (CDR).

children.title: The Requirements Baseline
children.content: Identify the specifications for the Requirements Baseline at the completion of SRR-2.

children.title: The Functional Baseline
children.content: Identify the specifications and architecture products for the Functional Baseline at the completion of SFR.

children.title: The Software portion of the Allocated Baseline
children.content: Identify the specifications for the Software portion of the Allocated Baseline upon completion of the SSR.

children.title: The Allocated Baseline
children.content: Identify the specifications for the Allocated Baseline at the completion of PDR.

children.title: The Product Baseline
children.content: Identify the specifications and drawings for the Product Baseline at the completion of CDR.

children.title: Other specifications
children.content: Identify other specifications as provided by the Government as Government Furnished Information.
